resources.string: Start recording. Triple-tap while idle to resize.
Bubble is on. Tap it in any app to dictate.
English dictation works offline once a model is installed.
Download a supported model, then select it above. Downloads use the internet. Speech stays on this device and is never uploaded.
Microphone permission is required to dictate.
Overlay permission is required for the floating bubble.
Nothing to copy yet. Record or type some text first.
This installation is missing its speech model. Install the complete preview APK.

Android accessibility access can read screen content and interact with apps. Flow uses it to detect focused text fields and insert dictated text at the cursor. Detection and dictation run on this device; field content, audio and transcripts are not uploaded. Flow does not insert into password fields.
Tap the microphone, speak, then finish to insert text. Some apps do not support insertion; Flow keeps the transcript for you to recover.
Setup needed: enable Flow under Installed apps or Downloaded apps in Accessibility settings.
Accessibility is enabled. Waiting for Flow to connect.
Automatic typing is ready. Open a text field in another app to use it.
Open phone Settings, then Accessibility, to manage Flow.
For a microphone that appears with the keyboard and inserts text, set up automatic typing.
Automatic typing needs accessibility access. Finish setup in Settings.
Automatic typing is on. The microphone appears in supported text fields and inserts your dictation.
Shows while a supported text field is active. Tap to dictate and insert text.
Automatic typing is set up. Enable the floating microphone to use it.
Automatic typing is paused. Enable the floating microphone in Flow to use it.
Keep a microphone over other apps. Automatic typing is available below.
Setup needed: allow Flow to appear on top so it can show the microphone.
Checks Android releases. Updates need your approval. A private repository opens in your browser so you can sign in.
No browser is available. Visit github.com/joenayer/flow-releases/releases to check for updates.

If Android blocks accessibility access, open phone Settings → Apps → Flow → More (⋮) → Allow restricted settings, then return here. The app may be listed as Flow Preview. Only allow access for an app you trust.
Offer vocabulary suggestions from my edits
While recording, hold the bubble to pause. Release to resume the same take.
Speech recognition: NVIDIA Parakeet model, licensed CC-BY-4.0
Keep names and special words spelled your way. Add what Flow sometimes hears as an alias. Boost is saved for future supported recognition models; aliases work with every model.
Could not read vocabulary. The saved file has been kept.
No custom words yet. Add a name or import a text file.
Entries with the same word will be replaced. Other saved words are kept.
Choose a file smaller than 2 MB.

On your Windows computer, run the Flow Wispr dictionary export helper. Move the transfer file it creates to this phone, then choose it here. This imports dictionary words and corrections; snippets are not included. The file is read on this device.

File entries: %1$d
New words: %2$d
New corrections: %3$d
Already present: %4$d
Conflicts skipped: %5$d
Review the new words and corrections below. A correction keeps the original spelling as “Heard as”. New corrections are added without removing saved aliases or changing boosts.
Only the new words and corrections shown will be added. Saved aliases and boosts will be kept.
Added %1$d words and %2$d corrections. Skipped %3$d already present and %4$d conflicts.
This file could not be imported. Choose the transfer file created by the Flow helper.
The file is not valid UTF-8 text.
